newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel's Netanyahu to cut short U.S. trip.
newsitem.headline: Israel's Netanyahu to cut short U.S. trip.

text.p: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu will cut short a visit this week to the United States following the death of 73 soldiers in the worst military air disaster in Israel's history, a spokesman said on Sunday.

Netanyahu's trip, due to begin on Wednesday, would end on Saturday night, two days early, because of the deaths in the collision of two helicopters, the spokesman said. He will meet U.S. President Bill Clinton in Washington on Thursday.
